senses.gloss: to heap up, to put up stacks of grain.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 56a">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 71a:15">Men. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>גּוֹדְשִׁין לפני העומר</he> they put the stacks of grain up before offering the Omer (v. <cite ref="P00288"><he>עוֹמֶר</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:1">Tosef. Pes. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:19">III</cite>), 19 (corr. acc.).
Tosef. B. Kam. VI, 24 השאילו לִגְדּוֹשׁ … וגָ׳ וכ׳ if he lent him a spot to pile wheat on it, and he piled barley; a. fr.—2) to give heaped measure, opp. מחק to strike.

B. Bath. V, 11 where the usage is למחוק לא יִגְדּוֹש וכ׳ to strike grain, one must not heap (even for special remuneration) &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. גָּדוּשׁ, f. גְּדוּשָׁה, brimful, overflowing, heaped.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>חטאו … ג׳ ומְגוּדָּשׁ</he> the measure of thy sin is heaped to excess.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 153b:5">Sabb. 153ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:17">Tosef. ib. I, 17</cite>; Y. ib. I, 3ᶜ (<he>את ה</he>)<he>סאה בו ביום גָּדְשׁוּ</he> on that day (of rabbinical enactments) they overfilled the measure (of laws).

senses.gloss: to be heaped up, to tower up.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 9:5">Men. IX, 5</cite> <he>היו נִגְדָּשׁוֹת</he> were heaped, v. <cite ref="C00320"><he>גּוֹדֶשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 34a">Sot. 34ᵃ</cite> the waters <he>נִגִדָּשִׁין ועולין</he> rose more and more.
